title: Backstage
description: Backstage backend OpenTelemetry metrics: catalog, scaffolder, scheduler, HTTP, MCP actions, runtime.

panels.title: Catalog entities
panels.description: Total entities across all kinds.

targets.expr: max(sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"catalog_entities_count", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}))
max(sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"catalog_registered_locations_count", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Stitching queue
panels.description: Entities waiting to be stitched. A steadily growing value means stitching can't keep up.

targets.expr: max({__name__=~"catalog_stitching_queue_length", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Processing errors (1h)
panels.description: Entities whose processing returned errors or failed in the last hour.

targets.expr: sum (increase({__name__=~"catalog_processed_entities_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", result=~"errors|failed"}[1h]))

panels.title: Scaffolder success (24h)
panels.description: Share of scaffolder tasks that finished ok in the last 24h (cancelled counts against).

targets.expr: sum (increase({__name__=~"scaffolder_task_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", result="ok"}[24h])) / clamp_min(sum (increase({__name__=~"scaffolder_task_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[24h])), 1)

panels.title: Failed scheduled tasks (1h)
panels.description: Backend scheduler task runs that failed in the last hour, all plugins.

targets.expr: sum (increase({__name__=~"backend_tasks_task_runs_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", result="failed"}[1h]))

panels.title: Entities by kind
panels.description: catalog_entities_count, broken down by kind. Max across replicas, since every replica reports the same DB-backed value.

targets.expr: max by (kind) ({__name__=~"catalog_entities_count", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Processed entities / s by result
panels.description: changed / unchanged / errors / failed. A rise in 'errors' usually means a broken catalog-info.yaml or a failing processor.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processed_entities_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Processing duration
panels.description: Full processing loop per entity (read → processors → write).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processing_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processing_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processing_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Processors duration p95 by result
panels.description: Time inside the processor chain only. Compare with total processing to see whether processors or the DB is the bottleneck.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, result) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processors_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Processing queue delay
panels.description: How late entities are picked up relative to their scheduled refresh. Growing delay = processing capacity is short.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processing_queue_delay(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_processing_queue_delay(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: SCM events received / s
panels.description: Webhook-driven SCM events (e.g. GitHub push) handled by the catalog. Flat at zero if you don't use the events backend.

targets.expr: sum by (eventType) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_events_scm_messages_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Stitching queue
panels.description: Entities pending stitching.

targets.expr: max({__name__=~"catalog_stitching_queue_length", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"})
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_stitching_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"catalog_stitching_queue_delay(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum (rate({__name__=~"catalog_stitched_entities_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Task runs by result
panels.description: Count of finished scaffolder tasks per interval.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (increase({__name__=~"scaffolder_task_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", template=~"$template"}[$__interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, template) (rate({__name__=~"scaffolder_task_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Step duration p95 (top 10 steps)
panels.description: Slowest steps — typically publish:* and long-running fetch/terraform actions.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, template, step) (rate({__name__=~"scaffolder_step_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Template outcomes (selected range)
panels.description: Runs per template and result over the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: sum by (template, result) (increase({__name__=~"scaffolder_task_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", template=~"$template"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Failing steps (selected range)
panels.description: Which template steps fail most. Empty means no failed steps in range.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (template, step) (increase({__name__=~"scaffolder_step_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", result="failed", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Task runs / s by plugin & result
panels.description: Catalog providers, search indexers, techdocs builds etc. all run through the scheduler.

targets.expr: sum by (pluginId, result) (rate({__name__=~"backend_tasks_task_runs_count_total", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", result!="started"}[$__rate_interval]))
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, taskId) (rate({__name__=~"backend_tasks_task_runs_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Time since last completed run
panels.description: Seconds since each scheduled task last completed successfully. Compare against the task's configured frequency — a value far beyond it means the task is stuck or failing.

targets.expr: time() - max by (pluginId, taskId) ({__name__=~"backend_tasks_task_runs_completed", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod", result="completed"})

panels.title: Requests / s by route
panels.description: Needs stable HTTP semconv: set OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=http on the backend.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (http_route) (rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration(_seconds)?_count", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration(_seconds)?_count", http_response_status_code=~"5..", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration(_seconds)?_count", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))))
sum by (mcp_method_name, gen_ai_tool_name) (rate({__name__=~"mcp_server_operation_duration(_seconds)?_count", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (error_type) (rate({__name__=~"mcp_server_operation_duration(_seconds)?_count", error_type!="", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_tool_name) (rate({__name__=~"mcp_server_operation_duration(_seconds)?_bucket", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Event loop delay p99
panels.description: From @opentelemetry/instrumentation-runtime-node. Sustained >100ms makes the whole backend feel slow.

targets.expr: max by (pod) ({__name__=~"nodejs_eventloop_delay_p99(_seconds)?", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"v8js_memory_heap_used(_bytes)?", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Container memory (working set)
panels.description: cAdvisor — independent of the OTel setup.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"})
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))
